Name: (JA) Syds Plaids
Author: susceptiveGalaxy
Description:
[center][size=6]A big thank you to [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/26612284-paradigmnomad/]paradigmnomad[/url]﻿ for converting this mod to 1.4! Send them lots of love and thanks! <3[/size][/center]
[center]-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/center]
[center][size=5]Due to the new clothing system in 1.4, you will need to download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]﻿ or something similar to access these shirts.[/size][/center]

[size=4]IRL, flannels make up a good 75% of all of my outfits. I have one of nearly every color. However, Stardew Valley doesn't really have any flannels in-game. I thought I'd make my own in every color. [/size]
[size=3]The colors are very saturated, but if you want to edit them to be less so, go ahead. Just don't re-upload without credit![/size]

[size=4][b]INSTRUCTIONS[/b][/size]
[size=3]1. [/size]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and install accordingly [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#installing-smapi](a guide)[/url]
[size=3]2. [/size]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]JSON Assets[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]
[size=3]3.[/size] Download this mod and extract the zipped file
[size=3]4.[/size] Drop the folder "[JA] Syds Plaids" into your "mods" folder (Program Files (x86) -> Steam -> steamapps -> common -> Stardew Valley -> mods)
[size=3]5.[/size] Launch SMAPI and enjoy!
